name: early_move_continuation_barvolspike
notes: Sensitivity variant of early_move_continuation (2026-09-25): replaces cum_vol_vs_adv20 >= 0.3 (cumulative volume vs 20-day ADV) with bar_vol_spike >= 2 (this bar's volume vs the mean bar volume over the prior 20 minutes). bar_vol_spike is a rate/pace measure like production's live `rvol` gate (rvol >= 2 in the avoid_chase_extended trigger), just computed per-bar over a short trailing window rather than against a time-of-day-normalized minute profile -- the closest analog schema_lab.py's 59 fields can offer to what production actually gates on.
